zh: 修复首页「全部工具」按最新排序时 AI BI 等页面因复用跨页脚本或安装包重置修改时间而误排到最前的问题；桌面打包构建期同步生成内置页面真实更新时间清单（page-updates.json）。
峰会演示文稿（ai-en）、提词器（we-ai）与字幕组件新增主/副字幕字号（小/中/大）独立调节及同步校验，并更新对应演讲配音音轨。
en: Fixed newest-first tool sorting in Home Workspace where pages reusing cross-page assets (such as AI BI) or packaged builds with reset file mtimes appeared at the top; desktop builds now bundle git-based page-updates.json.

Added independent primary/secondary caption size controls (small/medium/large) with sync validation to the summit slides (ai-en), teleprompter (we-ai), and caption module, along with updated narration tracks.
